title: Wooden Joe and the small spot on Claiborne and Tulane
summary: Dawson played tenor banjo in a little band with Wooden Joe, Manuel Gabriel and Sammy Penn.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever run with Wooden Joe much?

Wooden Joe, I used to play a little skacky job with them fellas, you know, like right there at the Claiborne and Tulane Avenue. They had a little spot there where he was playing. Oh, I remember that place.

Bear Farmer. Bear Farmer. Well, yes. They had a little fella called Leon Monfitt. Monfitt used to play piano, you see. And they had, uh, uh, this, uh, Gabriel, Manuel Gabriel. Manny Gabriel was playing saxophone. But I played tenor banjo, you see. And they had Tommy, uh, Sammy Penn on the drum. Well, that's about all they used there in that place there. They used there, they played there some of the nights a week, you see. Like a Wednesday night and a Saturday night, something like that.
I remember that place during the war. Was that Sammy Penn that plays drums with Thomas' band? Yeah, yeah. That's him.
I don't remember who was in the band in about 1910. I remember, about 1943, I heard him up there. Raffinini. Raffinini, yeah.
You might have been there, but I didn't know.
No, he had played at that place a long time. Yeah. Yeah, that played a long time.
